name: 20/20 Custom Molded Plastics
old_description: Our strength is in developing, improving, and initiating new and existing applications in both high and low pressure injection molding for cost reduction.
about:
20/20 Custom Molded Plastics operates from its headquarters in Bluffton, Indiana, with additional facilities in Holiday City, Ohio, and Covington, Georgia. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, nor are its founders named in available materials.

The company specializes in structural foam molding, structural web/gas assist, and high-pressure injection molding, running presses from 375 to 1,500 tons capable of producing single parts up to 200 pounds. A 135,000-square-foot, purpose-built facility houses custom shot-to-shot consistency controls, in-house engineering with CAD software, and secondary operations including assembly, machining, finishing, packaging, and drop shipping.

20/20 serves customers such as Yamaha, which has recognized the company with a supplier award, though specific industry sectors are not listed. The firm emphasizes part and mold design assistance, tooling management, and quality control tailored to each client.

Founded on a mission to exceed customer expectations, 20/20 differentiates itself through structural foam expertise that reduces resin use, cuts part weight by up to 15%, and leverages less expensive aluminum tooling. Custom nozzle controls and sequences ensure repeatability from prototype through long-term production.
